description: Count tokens (Anthropic-compatible) — Anthropic Messages API compatible token counter: POST the same body you would send to /v1/messages (model, messages, optional system and tools) and get {input_tokens} back before you send it. Handles text, image, document, tool_use and tool_result blocks plus tool-definition overhead, with a per-part breakdown. Heuristic estimate (typically within about 15% for English), no model call, instant. Use it to budget context windows and cost before calling /v1/messages. Price: $0.001 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: messages_count_tokens
